summary: User sent 2000 USDC via Solana from Coinbase to an address provided by a family member who had downloaded an app presented as KuCoin from an official app store. The USDC was reportedly exchanged for a fake USDT token and the family member was unable to convert or return the funds.
prevention: Verify crypto apps through the provider's official website before installation / Send a small test transaction before transferring a significant amount
classification_warning: insufficient detail to confirm how the fake token substitution occurred
